profile.Name: Dimak
profile.Job: Co-leader of the Black Dragon Ninjas
profile.Personality: A maniacal, bloodthirsty Shek who greets intruders with glee. She eggs Buzan on and relishes his gory promises.
profile.Backstory: She shares the leadership of the Black Dragon Ninjas with Buzan, is the only Shek in their ranks, and keeps to the Tower of Ninjas. She carries a superb ninja blade, and the Holy Nation wants her for murder, robbery, assault, arson, and kidnapping.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Cackles 'Ohhoho!' and calls Buzan 'Bu'; in a fight she spits out single words like 'Kill!' and 'Bleed!'
